title: 제주도 흑돼지
scene: 제주 공항 렌터카. 친구 민준과 2박 3일. 내비가 전부 한국어라 길을 잃고, 흑돼지 집에서 사투리를 만난다
goal: Road trip Korean and a taste of Jeju dialect

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Set the navigation. "40 minutes to destination."

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: That was from the airport. Now it's black pork.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: What is black pork that we drive 40 minutes?

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: If you're in Jeju, black pork is the law.

turns.speaker: A
turns.ko: 또 국룰이야? 한국은 국룰이 몇 개야?
turns.rd: tto gungnuriya? hangugeun gungnuri myeot gaeya?
turns.en: The law again? How many laws does Korea have?

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: It's Jeju dialect. She said "how many people".

turns.speaker: A
turns.ko: 헐… 나 한국어 3년 배웠는데 하나도 모르겠어.
turns.rd: heol… na hangugeo 3nyeon baewonneunde hanado moreugesseo.
turns.en: Whoa… I studied Korean for three years and understood nothing.

turns.speaker: C
turns.ko: ㅋㅋ 육지 사람이우꽈? 두 명 이쪽으로.
turns.rd: ㅋㅋ yukji saramiukkwa? du myeong ijjogeuro.
turns.en: Haha, from the mainland? Two, this way.
turns.note: 육지 = the mainland (how Jeju people call the rest)

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: So… this is a foreign country. Foreign.
